classification_definitions.fixed_locally: Current source and deterministic local regression evidence cover the reported behavior; production/device acceptance is not implied.
classification_definitions.needs_uat: Relevant code exists locally, but deployment, provider, physical-device, owner or populated-data acceptance is still required.
classification_definitions.remaining_contract: The requested behavior is not fully implemented or requires an explicit product/accounting/AI contract before implementation.
